name: Charge!
descriptionTemplate: Gain [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus, the next Vortice Exalt Crit. Rate +[Arg2]%. {Aftershock}: other Awakeners gain [Energy:Arg3] Aliemus.
lore: Ever since Vortice learned to restrain her strength during experiments, her capacity for destruction has surged. When the air around her grows unnaturally damp, it is a signal to clear the area immediately. As Vortice puts it: "Charge first! Then fire! Max power!!"
